name: RC-505
about: BOSS five-track loop station with rhythm, input and track FX.
source: BOSS RC-505 Owner's Manual (c. 2013), 'Assign' p. 17-18 and 'Controlling Devices via MIDI' p. 25-29, https://static.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/RC-505_e02_W.pdf; Version 2.0 Supplementary Manual, https://static.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/RC-505_V2_e02_W.pdf
notes: Original RC-505 has 8 assigns per phrase memory (the default ones are an EXP pedal, CTL1 undo/redo and CTL2 rhythm level), so set up in the Assign page: Source = CC#1-#31 / CC#64-#95 as listed, Target = TGT TR REC/PLAY for CC 14, TGT TR STOP 15, TGT TR CLEAR 16, TGT TR UNDO/REDO 17, ALL START/STOP 18, TEMPO(TAP) 19, INPUT FX ON/OFF 20, TRACK FX ON/OFF 21, then save to the phrase memory. The TGT TR targets act on the Target Track set in the same page (not per-track CCs). Set Sys MIDI Rx Ch to the Soba channel (factory 1; Omni is a separate setting). CC on/off values are an assumption. Phrase memories 1-99 by program change 1-99; 100-128 ignored; Bank Select ignored.
